title: In a menu-driven dialogue, asking a topic removes it from the list and the remaining options silently renumber. At the Regent's Chambers this caused a misclick: after asking a question, option 6 ('the Kingswood's oaks', an inert lore question moments before) had shifted to be 'negotiate the terms first (Envoy)', a real, consequential commitment — I ended up taking the Regent's oil and costing Osk/Lys disapproval without meaning to select that option.
where: The Regent's Chambers / talk to Regent Ysolde
